# ezghcloud_ssh_key (Resource)

An uploaded SSH public key. Deleting it does not alter copies on existing instances.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String)
- `project_id` (String) Project identifier.
- `public_key` (String) One OpenSSH public key line. Changing the key replaces this resource.

### Optional

- `tags` (Map of String) Resource tags.

### Read-Only

- `fingerprint` (String)
- `id` (String) Canonical prefixed resource identifier.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization managed by the configured provider.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Replace identifiers with values from your organization.
terraform import ezghcloud_ssh_key.example 'ORGANIZATION_ID/PROJECT_ID/RESOURCE_ID'
```
